title: Edmund and the Letters
author: Sable Oyelaran
blurb: Quentin Nakamura, a lighthouse keeper's granddaughter and part-time novelist, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. But when a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must let someone stay after the last train leaves, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
